notes: Contradiction-safe enrichment of the existing canonical Nuits-Saint-Georges white/red village and Premier Cru spec IDs from the current 2025 ministry specification homologated 24 December 2024.

Current 2025 specification makes the 180 g/L red village maturity floor, 13.5% enriched total-alcohol ceiling, elevage through 15 June N+1 and release from 30 June N+1 machine-executable.
Current 2025 specification makes the 187 g/L white Premier Cru maturity floor, 14.0% enriched total-alcohol ceiling, elevage through 15 June N+1 and release from 30 June N+1 machine-executable.
Current 2025 specification makes the 189 g/L red Premier Cru maturity floor, 14.0% enriched total-alcohol ceiling, elevage through 15 June N+1 and release from 30 June N+1 machine-executable.
